description: Learned site layout patterns — updated when recipes are pushed from the Parish Trainer extension. No AI keys required.

pdf_link_list+click_then_pdf.label: News page with PDF links
pdf_link_list+click_then_pdf.advice: Click Find bulletin → Pick newest, or Follow a link to the latest PDF.

wp_pdfemb_list+click_then_pdf.label: WordPress PDF embed list
wp_pdfemb_list+click_then_pdf.advice: Click the top/newest date card, then Get a PDF.

wix_html+html_capture.label: Wix HTML bulletin
wix_html+html_capture.advice: Bulletin text is on the web page — not a downloadable PDF file. Use Save page as PDF on the newsletter article page. Harvester prints the page to PDF each Sunday (Pattern clonleigh uses predicted WP post URLs).
operator_notes: Bulletin text is on the web page — not a downloadable PDF file.
Use Save page as PDF on the newsletter article page.
Harvester prints the page to PDF each Sunday (Pattern clonleigh uses predicted WP post URLs).
do_not: Do not use Pick bulletin image when the page is mostly text paragraphs.
Do not stop at click-only — need print_to_pdf as the final step.

html_click_chain+click_chain.label: Menu then redirect PDF
html_click_chain+click_chain.advice: Follow links through the menu (e.g. Newsletter), then Get a PDF on the final page.

oneweb_docx+direct_docx.label: One.com Word bulletin (Google preview iframes)
oneweb_docx+direct_docx.advice: Many docs.google.com/viewer iframes load slowly (2–4 min) — ignore previews. Bulletin is a Word file at onewebmedia/NEWSLETTER D-M-YY.docx — download directly. Iframe src URLs are in the HTML immediately; no need to wait for previews. Harvester rewrites the date each Sunday and tries filename variants (spaces before .docx).

Do not use goto-only recipes on this page.
Do not train on financial-statement or admin docx files.

parish_messenger_embed+click_then_pdf.label: Parish Services / Parish Messenger widget
parish_messenger_embed+click_then_pdf.advice: Wait for widget to load, then pick newest View Newsletter row. Ignore Gift Aid and Data Entry PDFs in the menu.
operator_notes: Wait for widget to load, then pick newest View Newsletter row.
Ignore Gift Aid and Data Entry PDFs in the menu.
do_not: Do not pick admin PDFs from the widget list.

direct_pdf+click_then_pdf.label: direct_pdf
direct_pdf+click_then_pdf.advice: News page has a stable link: CLICK HERE to load Current Newsletter. The PDF path changes weekly (/pdf/DDMMYY.pdf) — harvest by link text, not by fixed URL. Do not start the recipe on the PDF URL.
operator_notes: News page has a stable link: CLICK HERE to load Current Newsletter.
The PDF path changes weekly (/pdf/DDMMYY.pdf) — harvest by link text, not by fixed URL.
Do not start the recipe on the PDF URL.

image_bulletin+html_capture.label: image_bulletin
image_bulletin+html_capture.advice: Click Get an image or Pick an image on this page.

image_bulletin+image_capture.label: image_bulletin
image_bulletin+image_capture.advice: Click Get an image or Pick an image on this page.

iframe_viewer+html_capture.label: iframe_viewer
iframe_viewer+html_capture.advice: Click It's in a frame / viewer and choose the bulletin frame.

direct_pdf+direct_download.label: direct_pdf
direct_pdf+direct_download.advice: Bulletin is a real PDF (often made in Microsoft Word → Print to PDF). Tab title may say .docx or .jpg — ignore that; check the address bar ends in .pdf. On the PDF page: tap Save this PDF — saves the full https://… address for Sunday harvest. Or start on parishnews.html → point at this week's link → Yes → Save this PDF. Harvester rewrites DDMMYY in the URL each Sunday (e.g. 140626 → 210626).
operator_notes: Bulletin is a real PDF (often made in Microsoft Word → Print to PDF).
Tab title may say .docx or .jpg — ignore that; check the address bar ends in .pdf.

Harvester rewrites DDMMYY in the URL each Sunday (e.g. 140626 → 210626).
do_not: Do not use use_page_url only — GitHub cannot read Chrome's internal PDF viewer address.
Do not worry if Document Properties title mentions Microsoft Word.

weekly_bulletin_download+direct_download.label: Weekly bulletin list with auto-download
weekly_bulletin_download+direct_download.advice: Homepage shows dated rows — click the cloud download on this Sunday's bulletin. PDF downloads automatically; trainer records the download URL. Harvester advances /Weekly-Bulletins/NNN/ by weeks since the example date. Joomla Dropfiles widget: cloud icon is a.mod_downloadlink — clicking the icon inside still counts.
operator_notes: Homepage shows dated rows — click the cloud download on this Sunday's bulletin.
PDF downloads automatically; trainer records the download URL.
Harvester advances /Weekly-Bulletins/NNN/ by weeks since the example date.
Joomla Dropfiles widget: cloud icon is a.mod_downloadlink — clicking the icon inside still counts.
do_not: Do not use Pick bulletin image — this is a PDF download site.
Do not stop at click-only — need a download capture step.

html_click_chain+html_capture.label: html_click_chain
html_click_chain+html_capture.advice: Click Follow a link to reach the bulletin, then Get a PDF or Mark as HTML.

wp_block_file_bulletin+direct_download.label: WordPress permanent bulletin page (wp-block-file)
wp_block_file_bulletin+direct_download.advice: Permanent /parish-bulletin/ URL — PDF filename changes weekly under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/. PDF is in object.wp-block-file__embed[data] — harvest scrapes the embed URL. Use url_pattern *bulletin*.pdf — never pin a dated filename.
operator_notes: Permanent /parish-bulletin/ URL — PDF filename changes weekly under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/.
PDF is in object.wp-block-file__embed[data] — harvest scrapes the embed URL.
Use url_pattern *bulletin*.pdf — never pin a dated filename.
do_not: Do not train on the homepage — use the dedicated bulletin page only.
Do not pin saintanthony.co.uk if the parish moved to saintanthonys.uk.

weekly_bulletin_download+click_then_down.label: Joomla Dropfiles cloud download (.docx → PDF)
weekly_bulletin_download+click_then_down.advice: Joomla Dropfiles — cloud ↓ icon (a.mod_downloadlink) serves Word .docx. Click the cloud on this Sunday's row — harvester converts docx → PDF automatically. Do not record diocese GDPR/Privacy PDFs — only mod_downloadlink on the parish host.

operator_notes: One.com WordPress — TLS is fast (~0.6s) but the page can hang past 60s on domcontentloaded.
Harvest uses commit navigation and a 2–3 minute budget (goto + image_stack).
While training, if the timer stays on Still loading past 45s, that is normal — push anyway.
New site saintanthonys.uk — permanent /parish-bulletin/ page (not saintanthony.co.uk).
PDF in wp-block-file embed (object[data=…bulletin….pdf]) — page URL never changes.
Harvest: goto /parish-bulletin/ then download *bulletin*.pdf from embed.
Real PDF files — mDocs Download column. Never Save page as PDF.
Use HTTP — HTTPS cert is expired.
mDocs table on /bulletins/ — first row is this week's PDF (Download link in column 3).
Page can take 3–5 minutes to load — harvest budget up to 10 minutes.
do_not: Do not use Save page as PDF — bulletins are downloadable PDFs in the mDocs table.
Do not use https://portstewartparish.website.

Bulletins are full-page images stacked on one page — newest week at the top.
Pick the first two images, or use Pick another image too after the first.
Harvester grabs the top N large images automatically each Sunday — no dated URLs.
do_not: Do not hardcode one image URL — it goes stale every week.
Do not Save page as PDF — that captures every old bulletin on the page.
